summary: Flutter now supports pinning a remote screen share in a workspace-level mini-player. It remains visible while navigating to another channel, a DM, or workspace panels; users can return to the voice viewer, mute screen audio for the current session without changing saved gain, or stop watching. Viewer selection is scoped to the active voice-channel ID.
